verdict.rationale: Angular is itself a first-party development platform. It ships official modules for forms, routing and more, plus an official CLI, all of which developers build against in TypeScript (angular-docs-3, angular-gh-1, angular-docs-9). Its 'AI-forward resources and integrations' claim and llms.txt hint at AI-native support (angular-docs-4, angular-probe-1), but nothing documents an AI-oriented or programmatic SDK as such. Missing for 10: documented AI-specific or agent-facing SDK packages, SDK reference docs or multi-language SDK coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against them.
